decisions.reason: Copper-coated glass substrates (ACT) sit close to the firm's core glass wafer competence and match its strategic push toward higher-value interconnect and glass-core packaging. Results in such development-driven markets are judged on a long horizon, so management will keep the line rather than read a short shortfall as a cue for problemistic search.

VLIS was only launched in 2024 as a flagship with its own page and targets through-glass vias for advanced semiconductor packaging, a growth field. Sunk R&D investment and an early-stage aspiration horizon make dropping it within a year very unlikely.
